says: Ana founds a Team; Ben and Cho join by invitation, verified key and consent, and each keeps on their own device the Team authority's control permit attesting their key. Ana grants Ben read, use, contribute and grant with room to delegate once, and grants Cho read and review. Ben seals a grant change giving Cho read and use, naming his control permit. Cho locks her profile, which moves her access generation from 7 to 8; her approval of Ben's change, sealed under generation 7, is not admitted locally (access_locked, access_generation_moved), and when it reaches the Team owner anyway it is refused with access_generation_moved. Ana's authority then revokes Ben's permit and Ben's device records the revocation; Ben's grant change, still naming that permit, is refused by the owner with credential_revoked. Neither refusal writes an approval or a grant, and neither moves the Team head.
